<script>
  (function () {
    if (window.__asrBrandApplicationTracking) return;
    window.__asrBrandApplicationTracking = true;

    var APPLY_PATH = "/join-as-a-brand/apply";
    var SUCCESS_PATH = "/join-as-a-brand/application-submitted";
    var PENDING_KEY = "asr_brand_application_pending_v1";
    var CAPTURED_KEY = "asr_brand_application_captured_v1";
    var ENTRY_KEY = "asr_session_entry_v1";
    var MAX_PENDING_AGE = 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

    function getEntry() {
      try {
        var existing = sessionStorage.getItem(ENTRY_KEY);
        if (existing) return JSON.parse(existing);
      } catch (_) {}
      var entry = {
        url: window.location.href,
        referrer: document.referrer || null,
      };
      try {
        sessionStorage.setItem(ENTRY_KEY, JSON.stringify(entry));
      } catch (_) {}
      return entry;
    }

    function getUtmProperties(url) {
      var params = new URL(url).searchParams;
      var result = {};
      [
        "utm_source",
        "utm_medium",
        "utm_campaign",
        "utm_term",
        "utm_content",
      ].forEach(function (key) {
        var value = params.get(key);
        if (value) result[key] = value;
      });
      return result;
    }

    function getSubmittedEmail(form) {
      var input = form.querySelector('input[type="email"]');
      var value = input && input.value;

      if (!value) {
        try {
          new FormData(form).forEach(function (fieldValue, fieldName) {
            if (
              !value &&
              typeof fieldValue === "string" &&
              /email/i.test(fieldName)
            ) {
              value = fieldValue;
            }
          });
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      value = typeof value === "string" ? value.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
      return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value) ? value : null;
    }

    getEntry();

    document.addEventListener(
      "submit",
      function (event) {
        if (
          window.location.pathname !== APPLY_PATH ||
          !event.target ||
          event.target.tagName !== "FORM"
        )
          return;
        var entry = getEntry();
        var pending = Object.assign(
          {
            created_at: Date.now(),
            email: getSubmittedEmail(event.target),
            entry_url: entry.url,
            entry_referrer: entry.referrer,
            application_url: window.location.href,
          },
          getUtmProperties(entry.url),
          getUtmProperties(window.location.href),
        );
        try {
          sessionStorage.setItem(PENDING_KEY, JSON.stringify(pending));
          sessionStorage.removeItem(CAPTURED_KEY);
        } catch (_) {}
      },
      true,
    );

    function captureCompletedApplication() {
      if (window.location.pathname !== SUCCESS_PATH) return;
      if (sessionStorage.getItem(CAPTURED_KEY) === "1") return;

      var pending;
      try {
        pending = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(PENDING_KEY) || "null");
      } catch (_) {
        return;
      }
      if (!pending || Date.now() - pending.created_at > MAX_PENDING_AGE) return;
      if (!window.posthog || typeof window.posthog.capture !== "function")
        return;

      if (pending.email && typeof window.posthog.identify === "function") {
        window.posthog.identify(pending.email, {
          email: pending.email,
          signup_source: "join_as_a_brand",
        });
      }

      window.posthog.capture("brand_application_submitted", {
        signup_source: "join_as_a_brand",
        conversion_type: "application",
        form_path: APPLY_PATH,
        success_path: SUCCESS_PATH,
        entry_url: pending.entry_url,
        entry_referrer: pending.entry_referrer,
        application_url: pending.application_url,
        utm_source: pending.utm_source,
        utm_medium: pending.utm_medium,
        utm_campaign: pending.utm_campaign,
        utm_term: pending.utm_term,
        utm_content: pending.utm_content,
      });

      try {
        sessionStorage.setItem(CAPTURED_KEY, "1");
        sessionStorage.removeItem(PENDING_KEY);
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    ["pushState", "replaceState"].forEach(function (method) {
      var original = history[method];
      history[method] = function () {
        var result = original.apply(this, arguments);
        setTimeout(captureCompletedApplication, 0);
        return result;
      };
    });

    window.addEventListener("popstate", captureCompletedApplication);
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", captureCompletedApplication);

    var attempts = 0;
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
      captureCompletedApplication();
      attempts += 1;
      if (attempts > 120) clearInterval(timer);
    }, 500);

    captureCompletedApplication();
  })();
</script>
